description: The cyc verb tree at api-version 2026-08-01. Generated from the OpenAPI document — docs/plan/21 § Generation. Hand edits are overwritten by ./build.sh Generate and fail the Generated surfaces gate.

globalFlags.name: --output
globalFlags.summary: table for humans, json for scripts. tsv because cut exists.

globalFlags.name: --query
globalFlags.summary: A JMESPath expression over the response — docs/plan/21 § Decisions.

globalFlags.name: --api-version
globalFlags.summary: Required on every request and defaulted to the version this tree was generated from. There is no 'latest' — docs/plan/10 § API versioning.

redis.name: redis
redis.title: Valkey cache
redis.summary: A managed Valkey cache with Sentinel failover, on spotahome/redis-operator. Valkey rather than Redis, per ADR-011; every Redis client works against it.

create.name: create
create.summary: Create or replace a Valkey cache.

flags.name: --class
flags.summary: StorageClass name. Empty means the cluster default.

flags.name: --cluster-id
flags.summary: The cluster whose namespace holds the RedisFailover.

flags.name: --cpu
flags.summary: Explicit vCPU quantity in Kubernetes form, for example 500m or 2. Empty means take it from the preset.

flags.name: --enabled
flags.summary: Whether the operator runs a metrics exporter beside every Valkey and every Sentinel pod.

flags.name: --fsync
flags.summary: How often the append-only file reaches the disk. Read only when the mode is AOF; everysec can lose the last second of writes.

flags.name: --location
flags.summary: The region the cache is billed in.

flags.name: --maxmemory-policy
flags.summary: What happens when the cache reaches its memory limit. noeviction returns an error to the writer rather than dropping a key somebody is relying on.

flags.name: --memory
flags.summary: Explicit memory quantity in Kubernetes form, for example 4Gi. Empty means take it from the preset. It also sets maxmemory, so a cache evicts or refuses before the kernel kills the pod.

flags.name: --mode
flags.summary: Replication topology. Sentinel is the only one this operator implements, and a client written against it is not portable to a sharded deployment, so it may not change after create.

flags.name: --name
flags.summary: The resource's name within its group.

flags.name: --persistence-mode
flags.summary: None keeps nothing, RDB snapshots periodically, AOF appends every write.

flags.name: --preset
flags.summary: A sizing preset from docs/plan/12. Caches use the m1 family, which is 1 vCPU to 8 GiB.

flags.name: --replicas
flags.summary: Number of Valkey instances, including the primary. One is a single point of failure and is offered for development only.

flags.name: --resource-group
flags.summary: The resource group. docs/plan/06 § The hierarchy.

flags.name: --size
flags.summary: Persistent volume size in Kubernetes quantity form. Unused when the mode is None, which keeps the data directory in memory.

flags.name: --subscription
flags.summary: The subscription. Defaults to the current profile.

flags.name: --tags
flags.summary: Key/value tags, at most 50 pairs — docs/plan/06 § Tags, locks. Values are strings; the cap applies to the merged set, so a PATCH that adds one tag to a full bag is refused.

flags.name: --tenant
flags.summary: The tenant. Defaults to the current profile.

flags.name: --version
flags.summary: Major Valkey version. Minor upgrades are applied automatically in the maintenance window.

servers.name: servers
servers.title: PostgreSQL server
servers.summary: A managed PostgreSQL cluster on CloudNativePG, with replication, PgBouncer and backup to the tenant's object store.

create.name: create
create.summary: Create or replace a PostgreSQL server.

flags.name: --backup-enabled
flags.summary: Whether continuous backup and WAL archiving run.

flags.name: --class
flags.summary: StorageClass name. Empty means the cluster default.

flags.name: --cluster-id
flags.summary: The cluster whose namespace holds the CloudNativePG objects.

flags.name: --cpu
flags.summary: Explicit vCPU quantity in Kubernetes form, for example 500m or 2. Empty means take it from the preset.

flags.name: --database
flags.summary: Name of the application database created on first start.

flags.name: --destination-path
flags.summary: Object-store URL for base backups and WAL, for example s3://tenant-bucket/postgres. Empty means the platform fills it in from the tenant's default bucket.

flags.name: --extensions
flags.summary: Extensions to install, from the platform allow-list. An arbitrary-extension escape hatch is a code-execution surface and is not offered.

flags.name: --instances
flags.summary: Number of pooler pods.

flags.name: --location
flags.summary: The region the server is billed in.

flags.name: --memory
flags.summary: Explicit memory quantity in Kubernetes form, for example 4Gi. Empty means take it from the preset.

flags.name: --mode
flags.summary: PgBouncer pooling mode. Transaction pooling is the useful one and breaks session-scoped features such as prepared statements and advisory locks.

flags.name: --monitoring-enabled
flags.summary: Whether CloudNativePG emits a PodMonitor for the platform's metrics stack.

flags.name: --name
flags.summary: The resource's name within its group.

flags.name: --owner
flags.summary: Role that owns the application database.

flags.name: --pooling-enabled
flags.summary: Whether to run a connection pooler. On by default — a managed Postgres without one fails at the first serverless workload, and adding it later changes the connection string.

flags.name: --preset
flags.summary: A sizing preset from docs/plan/12. Databases use the s1 family, which is 1 vCPU to 4 GiB.

flags.name: --replicas
flags.summary: Number of instances, including the primary. One is a single point of failure and is offered for development only.

flags.name: --resource-group
flags.summary: The resource group. docs/plan/06 § The hierarchy.

flags.name: --retention-days
flags.summary: How long base backups and WAL are kept. The point-in-time-recovery window is this number of days.

flags.name: --size
flags.summary: Data volume size in Kubernetes quantity form. Grows online; never shrinks.

flags.name: --subscription
flags.summary: The subscription. Defaults to the current profile.

flags.name: --synchronous-replication
flags.summary: Whether commits wait for a replica. Costs write latency and removes the window in which a failover loses transactions.

flags.name: --tags
flags.summary: Key/value tags, at most 50 pairs — docs/plan/06 § Tags, locks. Values are strings; the cap applies to the merged set, so a PATCH that adds one tag to a full bag is refused.

flags.name: --tenant
flags.summary: The tenant. Defaults to the current profile.

flags.name: --version
flags.summary: Major PostgreSQL version. Minor upgrades are applied automatically in the maintenance window.

flags.name: --wal-size
flags.summary: Size of the separate write-ahead-log volume. Empty means the WAL shares the data volume.
